answers.p1: Evaluated flags are cached for 30 seconds.
answers.p2: Flag names must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ (lowercase kebab-case), otherwise define() raises ValueError.
answers.p3: evaluate() returns False for an unknown flag and never raises.
answers.p4: Tests must never write to config/flags.json because the service reads it live.
answers.p6: Percentage rollouts are listed as not started.
answers.p7: Audit log first, then percentage rollouts, then admin UI.
